content: Zingnah lang letah thawzaang a chongpaw kaaning sahlo tahei thawzaang a diapaw sahlo aa hmingrih khah phokhui he peh seh. Kaaning kaa zawng longtei a rawh kheh he peh seh.
Zingnah letah kaa uny sahlo aa changchyná pawtah ming maikaw tah aa chah nápaw khah tua he peh.
Khri zong tahei Ama zawng longtei a rawh be, Capathai letah, “Nama a ca minghnawh paw sahlo aa ca minghnawhnah cawh ka cung letah a tlah,” a tahpaw hrakhei a cang hri.
A khung ciapaw cai letah za ciapaw maikaw cawh kaaning cawngpahnah cawtah a cang. Ingkhynah thongtah le Capathai thawzaang pehnah thongtah hnabeisuinah kaa hnui nápaw cawtah a cang.
Khri Zisu a zuipaw naa cangpaw hratah ingkhynah le pasynah a ca peitu he Khazing taco a pungkhehnah ca pei ky he seh.
Ma pawsui co, lungkheh teitah le hmokaw sangkheh tah kaa Buipaw Zisu Khri a Paw le a Khazing cawh naa reithai khy a.
Khri tei a ca cyhlangpaw he hrakhei Khazing tah reithainah a hmuh nápawtah pakheh le pakheh a cyhlang my lo.

Ka reidupaw cawh ma heh a cang. Khri cawh Juda cawngsaw sae tah a za cangpaw cawh Khazing tei Juda cawngsaw pathlahtu sahlo khatei biakangnah a za tuapaw sahlo cawh a hmangpaw bia a cang tah khah palang a du cawtah a cang.
Ma pawsui co, Gental cawngsaw sahlo tah Khazing khah a zawngenah rawng tah aa parungnaw a. Capathai letah,

content.text: “Gental cawngsaw sahlo hrong letah ca reithai neh ka,
na ming cawh hlaw tah ka sá a,”

content: a tahpaw hrakhei le,
Capathai tei a tah vypaw cawh,

content.text: mingphing khaco a lawng my lo,”

content: a tahpaw hratah le,
Capathai tei a tah vypaw cawh,

content.text: “Gental cawngsaw vytei, Abuipaw cawh reithai la,
ming vytei sahlo Abuipaw cawh hlaw tah reithai my lo,”

content: a tahpaw hrakhei a cang.
Isaiah tei a rei vypaw cawh,

content.text: “Jesi a teisaw taitah pakheh a vong ka,
Gental cawngsaw sahlo uhtu tah tua a cang tae a.
Taico ama a cung letah aa hnabei aa sui a,”

content: a tahpaw hrakhei a cang.

Hnabeisuinah Khazing taco, Ama letah zingnah naa hnuipaw hratah naaning khatah alawngnah vytei le dená tah ca chisah ky he seh. Ma pawco, Thlawpaw Pathai hmingtuakhynah thongtah hnabeisuiná tah na chihlui he ceh.
Gental cawngsaw sahlo khatah phungreitu Paul
Ka uny sahlo, chahnah le hniná tah chih he ceh ka, pakheh le pakheh na cawngpah khy thlang he ceh, takhah kama hrahring tah a sepaw teitah ka hni thlang.
Canghrasala Gental hrong letah Khri Zisu raihretu ka cang khy nápaw tah Khazing tei apah pehpaw ningdonah thong hei naaning hnisah kaw ruapaw tah raechah teitah ka ciapaw a cang.
Ka pehlaipaw Gental sahlo cawh Thlawpaw Pathai tah pathai sá pawtah le cyhlang tlang aa cangná pawtah Khazing thawngchawbia kong lehei tlangbui rai ka hre.
Macawtaco Khri Zisu kha ka peitlenah thongtah Khazing rai ka hrepaw cawh ka hme a kai.
Gental cawngsaw sahlo khah Khazing nawngenah lang seikhui pawtah bia tah cang seh, tuasaná tah cang seh, paching pakhanah le ningang chuipaw tah cang seh,

Thlawpaw Pathai hmingtuakhynah thongtah Khri tei kama hmang tei a tuapaw longlong khah ka rei thlang a. Macawtaco Jerusalem taitah Illirikom raang tai khua ka za tlong tei ning takhei Khri kong thawngchaw khah tlangtling teitah ka rei.
Ka sadu thawpaw cawh Khri aa thui bang lynah hminghmaw letei thawngchawbia rei khah a cang paria thlang. Zecawtamaw tatah male tei a hrang aa za pathonah ciapaw letei sah cawh du bei neh.
Capathai letah,

content.text: “Ama a kong aa ching lypaw sahlo he takhei hmuh a he ka,
a thui lypaw sahlo takhei aa hni thlu tae a,”

content: tatah ciapaw hrakhei a cang.
Ma rai tahei naaning kha va tlongpaw khah a pa pakhang teipaw cawh a cang.
Paul tah Rom tlong a pachianah
Canghrasala atoheh cawh ma kuakaa hrong raang lehei ka rai cawh hre ruapaw a ung khawh lynah cawtah le naa hmui hmuh ka dunahpaw khah kung hlupui a cang thahnah cawtah,

ka ca tlong khy myca thly he a tah hnabeisuinah ka hnui. Spain raang lang ka seipai hei ca hmuh he neh seh la, tah heh du neh ka, naaning kha cai cuitei ka cang khy tah ma lang sei cawh pa baw tae la tah ka du.
Canghrasala atoheh cawh Jerusalem khua lang va sei taw neh ka, ma letei a ungpaw he mehpathai sahlo rai ka va hrepah taw he a.

Zemaw tahpaw co Masidonia raang le Grik raang letei a ungpaw khrisawbu sahlo tah Jerusalem khuapui letei a ungpaw he mehpathai sahlo hrong letei a sisahpaw sahlo bongnah rua pawtah aaning lungtho teitah aa thopaw tholong a ung.

Ma cawh aaning hrahring tah kaa tua a, aa tahpaw a cang. A ngetei tahpaw co, ma mehsisah bong cawh aa rai zong a cang thlang hrah. Juda cawngsaw tah Thlawpaw lang tei aa hmuhpaw bonghnang cawh Gental cawngsaw sahlo a hrong sahpaw he hratah Gental cawngsaw zong tah Juda cawngsaw cawh hmingbo lang tei bonghnang aa hmuhpaw khah aa hrongsah hrápaw he a cang.
Ma rai cawh pachang tah mehsisah caw tei aa thopaw tholong cawh a zongmingtei tah aaning khah ka peh thlu khy tai he tah Spain raang lang sei cawh a tho neh ka, ka ca tlong pai tae he a.
Naaning kha ka vong tihtah Khri bonghnang khah tlangtling teitah ka ca pho tae he a, takhah ka hni.
Uny sahlo, kaa Buipaw Zisu Khri le Thlawpaw Pathai pehpaw doná tah ca naw he neh ka, rai cawtah hei Khazing khatah thlawchang tah pa baw my lo.

Judia raang letei a ungpaw Khri a zing lypaw sahlo kih chung taitah ka bing nápawtah le Jerusalem khua letei a ungpaw caw tei tholong ka phopaw rai heh mehpathai sahlo cawtah cyhlang awh tlang a cang nápawtah thlawchang my lo.
Taico Khazing dunah a cang caco, alawngnah kha naa kung va tlung neh ka, naaning tlong cawh kaa dawngkasawny cawtah thawzaang tha lahnah a cang a.
Denah Khazing cawh naa zongmingtei cung letah ung ky seh. Amen.
